author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current drawing was a plain ring head with a moustache curve and a shoulder arc. It read as a generic user with a moustache: no hair, no ears and no beard. Redrawn after the reference: a hair dome over a gently sagging hairline, ears bulging at the sides, a two-scallop moustache under the nose, and a full beard rounding down to the chin. It now reads as a bearded man's head.
omissions: The shoulders and the mouth line inside the beard were dropped: the head gets the full height so hair, face band and beard each keep 8 units.
